elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 11.1 requires Vendor, at Customer's request, to provide transition assistance on expiry or termination. The request condition is controlled by Customer and the resulting duty is mandatory.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Section 11.1 expressly provides transition assistance “for up to six months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
On expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 11.2 requires Vendor to return all Customer Data after expiry or termination, independently of the alternative Customer-request trigger.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.2 states that return must occur within thirty days after expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard or commonly used format.
elements.evidence: Section 11.2 requires a “complete, commonly used, documented” format.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 11.2 expressly requires a machine-readable format and includes relationships and metadata reasonably necessary for use.

elements.element: Vendor must delete remaining Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Section 11.3 requires secure deletion after Customer confirms successful return, including deletion from backups as they cycle, subject only to an Applicable Law retention exception.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion after return of Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 11.3 requires an authorized officer to certify deletion in writing after the return-and-deletion process.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 11.1 requires transition assistance on expiry or termination at Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: The six-month assistance period in Section 11.1 encompasses the fallback 90-day period.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must export or return Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data after expiry or termination.

elements.element: The data export or return must occur within 30 days.
elements.evidence: Section 11.2 expressly imposes a thirty-day deadline.

result.reason: The operative language satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also the fallback. The changes replace the contradictory immediate cutoff/deletion provision, add the required transition assistance, and anchor data return to expiry or termination while preserving the existing detailed return, deletion, certification, and legal-retention protections. The redline is targeted and introduces no unrelated commercial obligation. Drafting is strong, though Section 11.2's phrase “after expiry or termination or Customer's request” could be made syntactically clearer by enumerating the alternative triggers.
